decisions.reason: Building on an established offer with a dedicated page keeps option value alive while uncertainty remains and costs are low.
Close to the established offer and with its own page, the option still holds potential despite uncertain gas-specific demand.
A dedicated page and high relevance to electricity customers make this a strong low-cost option worth keeping.
Low-cost supporting tool that complements the platform and retains option value.
Only mentioned on the website and similar to other products, it offers little unique value, so drop to release resources as an unrealized option.
